name: WooCommerce
storage_notes: Settings are individual options named woocommerce_* (plus woocommerce_email_* and page-ID options); payment gateway settings are one array option per gateway named woocommerce_{gateway_id}_settings. Products, variations, coupons and legacy orders are CPTs (product, product_variation, shop_coupon, shop_order) with data in post meta plus the wc_product_meta_lookup table. Orders may instead live in HPOS tables wc_orders, wc_order_addresses, wc_order_operational_data and wc_orders_meta when woocommerce_custom_orders_table_enabled=yes. Shipping zones use woocommerce_shipping_zones / _zone_locations / _zone_methods tables; tax rates use woocommerce_tax_rates. Product/variation/coupon data is post meta; order data is posts+post meta or HPOS tables. Always use wc_get_products()/wc_get_orders() and WC_* CRUD so the active data store is honoured.

settings.summary: Store currency code (ISO 4217, e.g. USD, EUR). Read via get_woocommerce_currency().
Currency symbol position: left, right, left_space, right_space.
Number of decimal places shown in prices (default 2).
Store base country/state in COUNTRY:STATE form (e.g. US:CA). Used for tax and shipping defaults.
Store address line 1; siblings are woocommerce_store_address_2, woocommerce_store_city and woocommerce_store_postcode.
Store city.
Store postal/ZIP code.
yes/no master switch for tax calculation; rates live in the woocommerce_tax_rates table.
yes/no whether entered prices are gross (tax inclusive). Read via wc_prices_include_tax().
yes/no master coupon switch.
yes/no global stock-management switch; per-product _manage_stock still controls each product.
Store weight unit: kg, g, lbs or oz.
Store dimension unit: m, cm, mm, in or yd.
yes/no allow checkout without an account.
Page ID for the cart page; siblings woocommerce_checkout_page_id, woocommerce_myaccount_page_id and woocommerce_terms_page_id.
Page ID for checkout; the settings UI forces it to differ from cart/my-account pages.
Page ID for My Account.
From name used by transactional emails.
From email address used by transactional emails (validated as email).
yes/no WooCommerce usage tracking consent.

Per-gateway settings array, e.g. woocommerce_bacs_settings, woocommerce_cod_settings, woocommerce_paypal_settings. Contains enabled (yes/no) plus gateway-specific keys; some gateways store API secrets here.
HPOS authoritative-storage switch (yes/no). Do not flip directly: orders must be synced and HPOS tables created first.

meta.summary: Product/variation SKU. Must be globally unique; use wc_get_product_id_by_sku() for lookup.
meta.format_notes: Plain string; write through set_sku() so uniqueness/lookup-table checks run.

meta.summary: Regular price, unformatted decimal string in store currency.
meta.format_notes: Use set_regular_price(); empty string clears it. _price is derived and must not be written.

meta.summary: Active sale price; empty means no sale.
meta.format_notes: Use set_sale_price(); pair with _sale_price_dates_from/_to if scheduled.

meta.summary: Computed active price used by sorting/filtering.
meta.format_notes: Derived by WC on save; direct writes desynchronise the lookup table.

meta.summary: Sale start as Unix timestamp; _sale_price_dates_to is the end.
Stock quantity when stock management is enabled.
meta.format_notes: Use set_stock_quantity(); WC applies wc_stock_amount() and fires stock hooks.
Use set_stock_status(); invalid values fall back to instock.

meta.summary: Backorder policy: no, notify or yes.
Per-product low-stock threshold; empty inherits the global setting.
Product weight in woocommerce_weight_unit; _length/_width/_height are the dimensions.
Featured image attachment ID; _product_image_gallery is a comma-separated list of gallery attachment IDs.
taxable, shipping or none; _tax_class is the slug ('' = standard).
yes/no virtual flag; _downloadable is the sibling downloadable flag.

meta.format_notes: Complex serialized structure; use WC_Product::set_attributes() with WC_Product_Attribute objects.

meta.summary: Lifetime sales counter maintained by WC.
meta.format_notes: Derived; direct edits break reports and the lookup table.

actions.name: create_simple_product
actions.summary: Create a simple product using the public CRUD API.

actions.name: update_product_price_and_stock
actions.summary: Change price, sale price, stock quantity/status and backorders through setters, then save.
actions.implementation: wc_get_product($id); set_regular_price(); set_sale_price(); set_stock_quantity(); set_stock_status(); save();

actions.name: delete_product
actions.summary: Trash or force-delete a product via WC_Product::delete().

actions.name: create_order
actions.summary: Create a new order, add line items, recalculate totals and save.

actions.name: update_order_status
actions.summary: Change order status immediately, optionally adding a note; fires status-transition hooks and customer emails.

actions.name: add_order_note
actions.summary: Append an internal or customer-visible order note.

actions.name: clear_product_transients
actions.summary: Delete cached product data after out-of-band product/meta changes.

actions.name: clear_order_transients
actions.summary: Delete cached order/customer order data after out-of-band order changes.

actions.name: rebuild_product_lookup_tables
actions.summary: Repopulate wc_product_meta_lookup for products (heavy; normally automatic on save).

actions.name: sync_variable_product
actions.summary: Re-sync a variable product's min/max prices and stock status from its variations.

objects.summary: Simple, variable, grouped and external products plus product_variation children; data in post meta and wc_product_meta_lookup.
objects.crud_notes: List: wc_get_products(['status'=>'publish','limit'=>..,'paginate'=>true]). Read: wc_get_product($id). Create: new WC_Product_Simple()/WC_Product_Variable(), setters, save(). Update: setters + save(). Delete: $product->delete($force). Find by SKU: wc_get_product_id_by_sku(). Never write _price or bypass save().

objects.summary: Orders and refunds; stored as shop_order posts (legacy) or wc_orders + address/operational/meta tables (HPOS).
objects.crud_notes: List: wc_get_orders(['status'=>'wc-processing','limit'=>..,'paginate'=>true]); HPOS-safe. Read: wc_get_order($id). Create: wc_create_order(), add_product(), calculate_totals(), save(). Update status: update_status(). Add note: add_order_note(). Use only WC_Order APIs so both storage modes work.

objects.summary: shop_coupon posts with amount/type/usage/expiry data in post meta.
objects.crud_notes: Read: new WC_Coupon($code_or_id). Set code, discount_type, amount, date_expires and restrictions via setters, then save(). List via wc_get_coupons()/WP_Query on shop_coupon if available; WP_Query on post_type shop_coupon is the fallback.

objects.summary: Shipping zones, their locations and method instances in woocommerce_shipping_zones/_zone_locations/_zone_methods.
objects.crud_notes: List: WC_Shipping_Zones::get_zones()/get_shipping_zones(). Read: new WC_Shipping_Zone($id). Create/update: setters + save(). Add method: add_shipping_method($type); remove: delete_shipping_method($instance_id). Cache group 'shipping_zones' is invalidated by the data store.

detection.active_check: class_exists('WooCommerce') and defined('WC_VERSION'); WC()->version / WC_VERSION gives the version (11.2.1).

pro_notes: WooCommerce core is free; paid extensions such as Subscriptions, Bookings, Memberships, WooPayments and marketplace gateways are separate plugins and are not present in this source (readme.txt:25,33). Do not assume their objects/settings exist.
No WooCommerce-branded Pro-only core settings were found; extension settings must be verified per extension.
gotchas: Call wc_get_product() only after woocommerce_init, woocommerce_after_register_taxonomy and woocommerce_after_register_post_type; wc_get_order() after woocommerce_after_register_post_type (includes/wc-product-functions.php:71, includes/wc-order-functions.php:89).

Use WC_Admin_Settings::save_fields() (includes/admin/class-wc-admin-settings.php:936) or replicate its sanitize callbacks before update_option(); direct update_option() bypasses validation and page-ID conflict checks.

Do not write _price or total_sales directly. Product save refreshes wc_product_meta_lookup only for changed lookup props (includes/data-stores/class-wc-product-data-store-cpt.php:964-969) and invalidates product cache groups (same file:1206-1209).
Out-of-band DB/meta edits require wc_delete_product_transients() or wc_delete_shop_order_transients(); for bulk product meta changes run wc_update_product_lookup_tables().

HPOS: woocommerce_custom_orders_table_enabled must only be changed through WooCommerce after sync; checking it directly is safe (CustomOrdersTableController.php:230). HPOS tables: wc_orders, wc_order_addresses, wc_order_operational_data, wc_orders_meta (OrdersTableDataStore.php:192-228).
Order status strings passed to update_status() need no wc- prefix; internal stored values include wc- (src/Enums/OrderInternalStatus.php:17-59). Status changes can send customer emails.
Variable product price/stock changes should be followed by WC_Product_Variable::sync($product, true) (includes/class-wc-product-variable.php:710).
WooCommerce's own REST API is available under wc/v3, but PressAgent should call the PHP CRUD APIs above directly; the REST layer adds auth/nonce and schema overhead.
Guard writes on current_user_can('manage_woocommerce') or the relevant product/order caps; shop_manager has narrower permissions.
